logistics.format: Three-part exam (Part 1: 125 questions / 150 min; Part 2: 100 questions / 120 min; Part 3: 100 questions / 120 min). Multiple-choice, Pearson VUE

formal: Bachelor's degree (or 2 years of internal audit experience required if no degree, depending on pathway)

recommended_certs.rationale: CIA は内部監査全般、CISA は IT 監査特化。両方を併用する監査人は多い。

plus.note: IIA established 1941; CIA is the only globally accepted internal-audit credential.

minus.note: Internal audit profession is broader than cybersecurity; security is one chapter.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Longstanding audit recognition, verified experience and Japanese availability support professional assurance responsibility across the three-part exam; broad audit scope does not establish technical-security expertise.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Three exam parts, verified experience and established internal-audit recognition support professional audit responsibility. Security is only part of its broader scope, and the multiple-choice format does not demonstrate technical assessment execution.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded three-part audit coverage, verified experience and established internal-audit recognition support professional assurance work. Its multiple-choice and largely nonsecurity scope do not demonstrate expert technical assessment.
